newsitem.title: USA: Exporters sell 405,000 tonnes corn to unknown-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Exporters sell 405,000 tonnes corn to unknown-USDA.

text.p: Exporters reported the sale of 405,000 tonnes of U.S. corn for delivery to unknown destinations, U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday.
The sale included 165,000 tonnes for 1996-97 delivery and 240,000 tonnes for 1997-98 delivery. The 1996-97 marketing year ends Aug 30 and the new market year begins Sept 1.
By law, exporters must promptly report sales of 100,000 tonnes of more but sometimes it can take a few days for the identity of the buyer to become known.
